description: FP_AP_20 is the drawing identifier for distribution enclosure cover in Hensel's ENYSTAR enclosure and distribution-system STEP collection. A distribution cover closes or guards the selected part of a distribution assembly. Its opening, removal and equipment interfaces must match the documented system configuration.

For example, in a modular distribution enclosure with separately scheduled covers, use the FP_AP_20 reference to coordinate cover fixing, operating openings and removal access. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as ENYSTAR_Abdeckung_geschlossen/FP_AP_20.stp for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep cover fixing, operating openings and removal access visible in the layout.
